verrou.trop_essais: Too many tries. Try again in {s} s.
verrou.code_trop_court: The code needs at least 4 characters.
verrou.hello_ou_code: Windows Hello or the Vision code to get in.
verrou.code: The Vision code to get in.
resume.ferme_gestionnaire_creneau: Blocked by a {decideur} until the next time slot
resume.ouvert_gestionnaire_creneau: Allowed by a {decideur} until the next time slot
maison.aide_choix: Exception: on all their devices, even if the category is blocked, but not during time slots. Always available: nothing closes it.
temps.donne: {duree} given, as soon as Home Assistant receives it.
personne.plus_aucun_appareil: This person has no devices anymore.
personne.aucune_regle: No rules to set here: the matching modules are turned off in Vision.
personne.regles_valent: They apply on all of {prenom}'s devices. A shared device keeps its own rules.
personne.pas_en_propre: {prenom} has no device of their own yet: only shared devices, which keep their own rules.
ajout.aide: “Their own”: the device follows {prenom}'s rules and schedule, and leaves the person who had it. “Shared”: it keeps its own rules, but also shows up on this page.
ajout.tous_deja: All devices are already on this page. A new device enrolls when you install Vision on it.
ajout.demande: Requested, as soon as Home Assistant receives it.
partage.aide: Sharing a device changes no rules: it shows up for each person, and each of them can get time on it.
mot.aide: The message shows up on {prenom}'s device.
demande.indice_lien: Paste the link or the site's name
demande.pourquoi: Why do you need it? The {decideurs} will read it.
demande.aide_duree: “Always”: every time your screen is allowed. “The whole category”: also what is blocked for the same reason (for example all games).
demande.lien_invalide: This link doesn't look like a site. Example: youtube.com
demande.tu_seras_prevenu: You'll see the answer here and in a notification.
vue.coupee: This feature is turned off in Vision (modules). It comes back as it was if it is turned on again.
fermes.securite_elements_one: {n} item, blocked everywhere for everyone. Unblocked in Vision.
fermes.securite_elements_other: {n} items, blocked everywhere for everyone. Unblocked in Vision.
exceptions.aide: What is decided name by name for this person, on all their devices, on top of the categories. Something blocked for everyone still wins.
exceptions.a_venir: Exceptions come with the next Home Assistant update.
exceptions.aide_toujours: Never blocked: even outside time slots, during “Block everything” or when the device is blocked (phone, tablet). The phone and emergency calls always are. Remove: the app follows the schedule again.
exceptions.titre_autorises: Follows the schedule: allowed even when its category is blocked, during allowed time slots
exceptions.indice: Name of an app or address of a site
exceptions.deux_lettres: Two letters are enough to search.
exceptions.rien_de_ce_nom: Nothing by that name. For a site, type its address (example.com).
temps.a_venir: Detailed screen time comes with the next Home Assistant update.
temps.detail_vide: The per-app details fill in from now on: nothing yet for today.
temps.aucun_releve: No data in the last few days.
planning.aide: The schedule belongs to the person: it applies on all their devices, except those a time slot leaves out. What you change here is the same schedule as in Home Assistant.
plage.heures_aide: From … to … (a time slot can go past midnight: 21:00 to 07:00)
plage.elements_aide: This time slot blocks specific apps or sites: that list is set in Home Assistant. Here you can change its name, times and days.
plage.ou_categories: Or only these categories (leave “The whole device” off):
plage.pas_sur_aide: On: the time slot leaves this device out.
plage.faute_nom: Give the time slot a name.
plage.faute_portee: Pick “The whole device” or at least one category.
plage.enregistree: Saved, as soon as Home Assistant receives it.
limites.aide: So many minutes a day. Once used up, the app is blocked until the next day, on all their devices.
limites.posee: {appli} limited to {duree} a day, as soon as Home Assistant receives it.
logiciels.intro: What Windows lists as installed on this device. “Block” blocks the software for the person, on all their devices; you can undo it in Permissions. “Uninstall” removes it from this device: it can't be undone.
logiciels.module_coupe: Uninstalling is turned off with Vision's “PC optimizations” module.
logiciels.eteinte: Uninstalling is off: turn it on in Home Assistant, Protection tab (“Uninstall by the agent”).
logiciels.liste_a_venir: The list arrives with this device's next report (every ten minutes while it is on, with an up-to-date agent).
logiciels.demandee: Uninstall requested: the agent takes care of it on its next round.
logiciels.bloque: Blocked for this person (undo in Permissions).
logiciels.confirmer: Uninstall from {appareil} for good? This can't be undone.
categories.aide: Red switch: blocked for this person, on all their devices. Tap a category to see what it contains. The schedule and automations add on top.
moi.refusee: Request declined. You can ask again at {heure}.
moi.ferme_ici_aide: Pick a line and ask for access: you'll say why and for how long, and a {decideur} answers from their phone.
moi.chercher: Search for an app or a site
moi.lien_presse_papiers: There's a link on the clipboard: {lien}
moi.site_hors_liste: A site that isn't on the list.
moi.demander_site: Ask for access to a site…
reglages.theme_pour_fenetre: For the Vision window on this computer.
reglages.verrou: Ask for Windows Hello or a code to open Vision
reglages.hello_pret: Windows Hello is ready on this computer (fingerprint, face or Windows PIN).
reglages.hello_absent: Windows Hello isn't set up on this computer: choose a code below.
reglages.verrou_aide: The lock comes back as soon as the window is closed.
agent.fonction_coupee: This feature is turned off in Vision (modules).
agent.pas_redemander: You can't ask for {nom} again right now.
agent.demande_envoyee: Request sent for {nom}. You'll be told the answer.
desinstall.raison_windows: is part of Windows or its protection
desinstall.raison_composant: is an internal component, not separate software
desinstall.raison_fabricant: comes from a hardware maker (probably a driver)
desinstall.aucun_logiciel: no software installed for the whole computer matches: remove it by hand
desinstall.pas_silencieuse: {nom} has no known silent uninstall: remove it by hand
desinstall.trop_long: the uninstaller didn't finish within fifteen minutes: remove it by hand
desinstall.abandonne: the uninstaller stopped without removing the software: remove it by hand
agent.preavis: This PC will be blocked {quand} ({heure}). Remember to save your work.
agent.preavis_motif: This PC will be blocked {quand} ({heure}): {motif}. Remember to save your work.
install.lien_expire: This installation link has expired or was already used.
install.lien_expire_aide: In Home Assistant: Vision → Configure → Add a device, for a new command.
install.integration_absente: The Vision integration isn't installed on this Home Assistant.
install.deja_inscrit: This PC is already enrolled in Vision.
install.deja_inscrit_aide: Home Assistant offers to take it back: follow the “Add a device” assistant.
install.cle_refusee: Home Assistant refused the enrollment key.
install.cle_refusee_aide: Check the key, and that “New PC enrollment” is turned on.
install.injoignable: Home Assistant can't be reached at this address.
install.auto_signe: If the certificate is self-signed, run again with -Insecure.
install.nom_du_pc: This PC is called “{nom}” in Home Assistant.
install.agent_introuvable_aide: Neither from {url}, nor next to this script.
install.description_tache: Applies the Vision schedule set in Home Assistant.
install.fin_visible:
The PC is now visible in Home Assistant, allowed and
with no time slot. Give it its schedule from the Vision
dashboard.
install.fin_mises_a_jour:
Agent updates then arrive on their own
from Home Assistant: nothing to reinstall.
desinstallation.dns: Browser DNS policies reset to default.
reglages.hello_demander: Ask for Windows Hello to open Vision
reglages.hello_aide: Fingerprint, face or Windows PIN. The lock comes back as soon as the window is closed.
reglages.hello_impossible: Windows Hello is not set up on this computer: the window cannot be locked.
reglages.code_ha: The management code, which releases a blocking message, is set in Home Assistant (Vision › Security): it is not stored on this PC.
code.envoi_echec: The code could not be sent.
code.aucun: No management code is set in Home Assistant.
code.inconnu: Home Assistant no longer knows this message.
code.verrouille: The management code is locked (too many wrong tries): release it from Home Assistant.
code.ancien: Home Assistant must be updated to check the code: release it from Home Assistant.
code.injoignable: Home Assistant cannot be reached: try again in a moment.
code.faux: That is not the right code ({n} attempt(s) left).
code.trop: Too many attempts. Try again in {min} min.
